description.value: Big Orange is a bubble tea franchise founded in Burnaby in 1996, with this being one of two Victoria locations. The shop specializes in fresh fruit bubble teas, ice cream bubble teas, waffles, and desserts, drawing on a menu developed from the brand's fruit-drink origins. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient downtown stop on Douglas Street for a cold, sweet refreshment.
